metric.semantic_locality.basis: single-language (Zig) shard; raw external-lookup counts recorded per frozen site_id using the matrix's site lists (identical site sets across languages). Cross-language common-basis reconciliation is performed by the aggregator once all language shards are merged, per interaction_with_quality_metrics.common_basis_rule.

illustrative_site_reasoning_examples.F02.P2: 'var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;' is Zig's genuine uninitialized-storage mechanism (not a substitution): all sites resolve from the local 'undefined' marker and explicit array type with zero external lookups.
illustrative_site_reasoning_examples.F03.P1: 'x += 1;' with x's declaration excluded as given context: mutability and value_vs_storage each require one hop back to x's declaration (NONLOCAL, lookup=1); overflow_exceptional_numeric and externally_visible_side_effects are resolved from the fixed checked-arithmetic language rule with no lookup (0). Probe mean = (1+1+0+0)/4 = 0.5.
illustrative_site_reasoning_examples.F05.P1: Bare call site 'f(x)' per spec 6.1.4.B: f's declaration is explicitly excluded from the fragment and counted as a non-local lookup (R5). aliasing_writable_aliasing, mutability, allocation_copy_move_borrow_destroy, control_flow_effect and externally_visible_side_effects all require consulting f's signature (lookup=1 each); value_vs_storage of x itself is local (0). Probe mean = 5/6 = 0.833, the highest-locality-cost probe in the Zig set, matching the spec's expectation that this probe measures call-site indeterminacy before consulting the callee.
illustrative_site_reasoning_examples.F05.P2: For this probe R5 places put's full declaration and body inside the measured fragment, so every site resolves locally with zero external lookups (mean=0), reflecting Zig's explicit '*i32' inout-style parameter form.

metric.semantic_locality.methodology_ref: semantic_compression.md section C (Semantic Locality) + semantic_site_matrix.json frozen site lists per probe
metric.semantic_locality.n_L_note: Zig fragment count for this basis: n_L = 42 of 44 frozen probes (F05.P3 and F14.P3 are NONE). Per interaction_with_quality_metrics.basis_reporting_requirement, this n_L must accompany the published figure; cross-language common-basis recomputation (probes where ALL TEN languages have a fragment) is the aggregator's responsibility once all ten language shards are merged.
metric.semantic_locality.normalization_formula: probe_mean_lookups = mean(lookups across that probe's frozen sites). language_mean_lookups = mean(probe_mean_lookups across all Zig-supported probes in the single-language basis, i.e. excluding probes scored NONE for Zig, per NA-4/exclusion-from-A-D rule). score = 100 * (1 - min(language_mean_lookups, 7) / 7), where 7 is the fixed maximum number of external-lookup categories enumerated in spec 6.1.3 Semantic Locality (callee signature, variable declaration, type declaration, overload set, trait/interface/protocol implementation, imported definition, global configuration/compiler mode). Higher score = lower lookup cost = better locality, consistent with 'lower lookup cost is better' and the 0-100/100-best convention.
metric.semantic_locality.raw_measure_definition: For each supported probe fragment, for each frozen site_id in that probe's site_order (from semantic_site_matrix.json), record the number of required external semantic lookups (declaration-graph hops) needed to resolve that site's semantic fact from the Zig fragment alone: 0 = EXPLICIT_LOCAL (resolved wholly within measured_fragment), 1 = one external hop (e.g. a callee signature, a variable/type declaration excluded as 'given context', an imported std-lib definition), 2+ = multiple chained hops. Only lookups required to resolve a frozen-inventory fact are counted (per spec 6.1.3 Semantic Locality: 'a lookup that is optional for extra detail must not be counted').

unsupported_probes_excluded_from_localit.F05.P3: Zig has no closures/function values that capture an enclosing local by value; the language provides only plain function pointers with no captured-environment mechanism. Scored NONE (N-1) for Zig capability coverage; excluded from this metric's numerator/denominator per interaction_with_quality_metrics (metrics A-D computed only where a fragment exists).
unsupported_probes_excluded_from_localit.F14.P3: Zig has no interface/trait mechanism supporting addition of a new implementation of an existing open abstraction from a separate compilation unit without editing the original; only closed tagged unions or hand-rolled vtables exist, neither of which satisfies the probe's 'abstract operation, two units, no edits to original' requirement in the frozen recipe. Scored NONE (N-1); excluded from this metric's basis.
